rationale: Select the registered structure reward because the only permitted coordinate reference is the original receptor-bound ligand pose. Its ligand anchor and contact shell are geometrical proxies, not affinity or interaction-energy targets; the supplied contacts do not establish causal anchors or an optimum. Use a modest contact term and reduced anchor weight as testable hypotheses, preserving some pose guidance while allowing graph transitions. Use repulsion_weight 2 as a steric-scrutiny hypothesis given the crop short nearest-neighbor distances, which are not localized and may not be clashes. Use native_rms_ratio 0.2 and time_ramp_power 1 as controlled candidate settings, not evidence-backed improvements. No generated Steer, lineage, temporal, elite-geometry, or history-matching information is available or used.
failure_modes: The original bound pose may overconstrain optimization or encode a pose that is not appropriate for molecules reached through graph transitions.
Untyped distance and Gaussian-shell contacts do not represent chemically specific interactions or binding energy, so increased contact reward may worsen predicted pIC50 or strain.
The short crop neighbor distances may be artifacts or genuine clashes; a global repulsion adjustment cannot localize or diagnose them.
No affinity labels, generated outcomes, matched controls, or replicate statistics support a claim that these settings improve pIC50 or strain.
The reward uses FLOWR endpoint VJP with detached correspondence; time derivatives are not spatial gradients, and whole-scalar rescaling may be canceled by gradient normalization.
